explicit_compiler.description: Two successful Wild processes wrote the same alpha path. All physical calls are kept and the accepted fixture requires one distinct path.

single_job_namespace.description: The distinct single-job namespace supplied a prior alpha output. The accepted adverse controls modify the observed eight-job output and check the touched path against the actual estimator.

synthetic_lockfile.description: The handwritten lockfile needed rewriting in the read-only canonical source. Cargo generated its own lockfile for the accepted fixture.
